title: Commissioner Gonzalez hosts 11th annual Veterans Thanksgiving Luncheon and Health Fair
excerpt: Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez hosted the 11th annual Veterans Thanksgiving Luncheon and Health Fair, and Webb County thanked veterans for their service and everyone who helped make the event possible.
content:
Commissioner Jesse Gonzalez hosted the 11th annual Veterans Thanksgiving Luncheon and Health Fair.

Webb County thanked all veterans for their service and everyone who helped make the event possible.

Source: Webb County, Texas, Facebook, Nov. 18, 2026.
